notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (B2B product) building an in-app conversational support assistant + doc search. Started with Hosted API for fast prototyping; now moving to Dedicated to control cost and meet data isolation requirements. Security: SOC2 + SSO/SAML required; want KMS support and audit logs.

POC specifics (agreed):
- Duration: 4 weeks; non-prod Dedicated tenant in us-east-1.
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests; telemetry hooks (latency, token counts, error rates).
- Week 2: Canary rollout (5% of real traffic) to Dedicated pool using routing policy; monitor p50/p95, error rate, token cost.
- Week 3: Expand to 30% if no regressions; exercise autoscaling and batch config.
- Week 4: Cost/quality analysis, rollback simulation and final runbook.

Canary + fallback details (customer wants explicit runbook):
- Primary model: curated high-quality variant (fp16 quantized where possible).
- Fallback model: cheaper quantized variant for cost spikes/degraded infra.
- Routing policy: prefer region-local Dedicated pool; if capacity >95% or latency >300ms p95 -> route to fallback model in same region for quality-preserving cost control.
- Region failover: if region outage or sustained p95>500ms for 2 consecutive 5-min windows, route to eu-west-1 Dedicated pool (with reduced context window).
- Rollback triggers: >1% error-rate increase over baseline for 10 minutes OR sustained p95 latency degradation >2x baseline for 15 minutes -> auto-roll to previous model version + alert on-call.

Metrics agreed: p95 latency target <=200ms for short-chat flows, token cost target <$0.015 per 1K tokens averaged over POC, accuracy/regression measured by sampled eval prompts (weekly).

Commercial/Procurement notes: team is price-sensitive but values predictable committed capacity. Initial ARR ask 75k-250k band. Legal needs DPA updates for EU data residency. Procurement timeline likely finishes by end of Q2.

Customer quotes: "We liked the Dedicated latency numbers on demo, but need the canary + rollback spelled out for engineering and SRE to sign off."
